mstts:express-as.prosody: Imagine a city alive with color and rhythm, where every street corner hums with possibility, and a young mind sees art in everything—from the vibrant graffiti on the walls to the pulsing beat of jazz echoing through the air. Welcome to a journey where creativity bursts from the heart of a child who refuses to be boxed in, no matter what the world expects. Together, we're about to explore Radiant Child: The Story of Young Artist Jean-Michel Basquiat, beautifully crafted by Javaka Steptoe. This is more than just a story about a boy becoming an artist. It's about the magic that happens when imagination meets determination, and how the love and encouragement of a caring mother can help a spirit soar—no matter the obstacles. As we follow Jean-Michel through moments of struggle, hope, and discovery, we’ll see how art becomes his way of making sense of a world that doesn’t always understand difference. His journey reminds us that real courage means staying true to your vision, even when it’s hard, and that creativity can be both a shield and a sword. So, let’s step into this vibrant world together. We’ll reflect on how self-expression shapes who we are, and how a child’s radiant spirit can light up even the darkest places. Get ready to discover how the power of art can leave a legacy that shines long after the paint has dried.
